mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, following_id, created_at) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followingId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.profile_image AS profileImage, -- 뷰어(viewerId)가 이 유저(u.user_id)를 팔로우 중인지 확인 (맞팔 체크) (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows f2 WHERE f2.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f2.following_id = u.user_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS isFollowing FROM follows f JOIN users u ON f.follower_id = u.user_id WHERE f.following_id = #{targetId}
